scripts.dev: bun run dev:db:prepare && bunx concurrently -k --names "web,backend,db,studio" --prefix "{time} [{name}]" --timestamp-format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold,green.bold" "bun run --cwd web dev" "bun run --cwd backend dev" "docker compose -f database/docker-compose.yml logs -f" "bun run --cwd backend db:studio"
scripts.dev:apps: bunx concurrently -k --names "web,backend" --prefix "{time} [{name}]" --timestamp-format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "bun run --cwd web dev" "bun run --cwd backend dev"
scripts.dev:db:prepare: docker compose -f database/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && bun run --cwd backend db:migrate
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose -f database/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f database/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && bun run --cwd backend db:push:force && bun run --cwd backend db:seed
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:backend
